theorems.name: Submission.lpf_tde_continuous_left_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ), ∃ Λ : (Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl n), ContinuousOn Λ {A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P | Function.Injective A} ∧ ∀ A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P, Function.Injective A → (Λ A).comp A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Eucl n) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ‖A (Λ A v)‖ ≤ ‖v‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
